# src

`main()`, `DllMain()`, `sdllp`, `component_loader`, `std_include`, `resource.hpp`, and `resource.rc` form the Windows DLL entry, system-library proxy, shared build configuration, resource-definition, and component-initialization layer for Project: Consolation.

## Contents

- [main.cpp](./main.cpp) defines `DllMain()`, `main()`, installation validation, DPI awareness, startup failure handling, and component-loader lifecycle calls.
- [resource.hpp](./resource.hpp) defines `ID_ICON = 102` and `IMAGE_SPLASH = 300`.
- [resource.rc](./resource.rc) embeds `VS_VERSION_INFO`, Visual C++ `TEXTINCLUDE` resources, DLL metadata, and conditional build flags.
- [sdllp.cpp](./sdllp.cpp) implements `sdllp::load_library()`, `sdllp::get_export()`, proxy-library policy, and exported `d3d9.dll` trampolines.
- [sdllp.hpp](./sdllp.hpp) declares `sdllp::get_export()`, `sdllp::libraries`, `sdllp::load_library()`, `sdllp::is_loaded()`, and `sdllp::log()`.
- [std_include.cpp](./std_include.cpp) defines telemetry no-ops, `NvOptimusEnablement`, Tommath RNG fallbacks, linker metadata, and the Common Controls v6 manifest dependency.
- [std_include.hpp](./std_include.hpp) configures Windows, CRT, GSL, STL, resource, version, GDI+, and Winsock includes for project translation units.

## Subdirectories

- [component/](./component/) contains gameplay, engine, gamepad, and utility components registered through `component_loader`.
- [exception/](./exception/) contains `create_minidump()` and Windows minidump-generation support.
- [game/](./game/) contains fixed-address engine bindings, ABI structures, symbols, dvar APIs, and runtime bridge functions.
- [loader/](./loader/) contains `component_interface`, `component_loader`, component registration, import dispatch, and shutdown behavior.
- [utils/](./utils/) contains flags, hooks, memory, PE I/O, module, string, and thread utilities.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`DllMain()` invokes `main()` during `DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH`, and `main()` invokes `enable_dpi_awareness()`, `validate_supported_install()`, `component_loader::post_start()`, and `component_loader::post_load()`.

`validate_supported_install()` checks `local_offline_mode_requested()`, `has_system_xlive()`, and `has_supported_multiplayer_marker()` before allowing component initialization.

`sdllp::get_export()` lazy-loads system libraries through `sdllp::load_library()`, resolves exports with `GetProcAddress`, and feeds `D3DPERF_BeginEvent()`, `D3DPERF_EndEvent()`, and `Direct3DCreate9()` trampolines.

`std_include.hpp` supplies shared platform declarations and linker libraries to `main.cpp`, `sdllp.cpp`, `std_include.cpp`, and nested source files.

## API Surface

`main() -> bool` returns startup status, while `DllMain(HINSTANCE, DWORD, LPVOID) -> BOOL` returns `FALSE` after startup failure.

`sdllp::get_export(const char*, const char*) -> FARPROC`, `sdllp::load_library(const char*)`, and `sdllp::is_loaded(const char*) -> bool` define dynamic-library resolution.

`ID_ICON` and `IMAGE_SPLASH` define resource identifiers consumed by Windows resource compilation.

## Configuration

`std_include.hpp` defines `WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN`, undefines `min` and `max`, disables selected MSVC warnings, and links `gdiplus.lib` and `ws2_32.lib`.

`resource.rc` uses `VERSION_FILE_RC`, `VERSION_PRODUCT_RC`, `VERSION_FILE`, and `VERSION_PRODUCT` for numeric and string version metadata.

`resource.rc` uses `_DEBUG`, `PRERELEASE`, `CI`, `AFx_RESOURCE_DLL`, `AFX_TARG_ENU`, and `APSTUDIO_INVOKED` to control version flags and generated resource sections.

`std_include.cpp` exports `NvOptimusEnablement = 0x00000001`, while non-`DEBUG` builds merge sections into `.UPX0` through `.UPX4`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`local_offline_mode_requested()` recognizes `offline`, `local_offline`, and `local-offline`.

`has_system_xlive()` checks `%SystemDirectory%\\xlive.dll` with `GetSystemDirectoryA`, `GetFileAttributesA`, `MAX_PATH`, and `FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY`.

`has_supported_multiplayer_marker()` reads `jb_mp_s.dll` RVA `0x0050502C` and requires case-insensitive equality with `"multiplayer"`.

`gfwl_update_url` equals `https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/1012-microsoft-games-for-windows-live/`, and `unsupported_update_url` equals `https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/1089-007-quantum-of-solace-patch/`.

`should_load_proxy_library("d3d9.dll")` returns `is_multiplayer_host()`, while non-`d3d9.dll` libraries return `true`.

`is_multiplayer_host()` recognizes `JB_Launcher_s.exe`, `JB_LiveEngine_s.exe`, loaded `jb_mp_s.dll`, or the `multiplayer` flag.

`singleplayer_warning_shown` gates `"Project: Consolation does not support singleplayer.\n\nLaunching without modifications using the default system d3d9.dll."`.

`create_minidump()` uses the `"Consolation -"` temporary-file prefix, `0x2000`-byte read buffers, and exit code `123` for `MiniDumpWriteDump` failure.

`main()` converts `"post start failed"` and `"post load failed"` failures into `"ERROR"` dialogs after invoking `component_loader::pre_destroy()`.

`FILETYPE VFT_DLL`, `OriginalFilename="d3d9.dll"`, `CompanyName="Consolation"`, `Licence="GPLv3"`, and `Translation 0x409, 1200` define the embedded DLL metadata.

`#pragma warning(disable: 4740)` permits inline assembly in naked `EXPORT` trampolines targeting `LIBRARY "d3d9.dll"`.
